title: Utv library component diagram
description: The Utv assembly: the JSON layer in this folder, the typed layer on top of it, and the internals both use. The structural schema is embedded from the repository; zone rules come from the caller.

components.name: JSON layer and validation
components.responsibility: UtvValidator and GregorianCivil (0.1), Build, Iso, TextForm, Calendar, Ranges, Zones, ZoneRules and Interop (0.2), all on UTV JSON as JsonElement, answering with UtvResult.

components.name: Typed layer
components.responsibility: One immutable type per everyday value, Outcome<T>, typed policies and TemporalContext (0.3).

components.name: Internals
components.responsibility: Strict JSON reading, the schema interpreter, and the helpers every everyday operation shares.

components.name: UTV 1.0 structural schema
components.responsibility: schema/utv-1.0.schema.json, linked into the assembly as an embedded resource.

components.name: Zone-rule bundle
components.responsibility: Rule data in the format of conformance/rules/demo-zones.json, chosen and loaded by the caller (ZoneRules.Load or ZoneRules.Parse).

components.name: .NET 8 base class library
components.responsibility: System.Text.Json, System.Numerics.BigInteger, System.Text.RegularExpressions, and the native date and time types the interop converts.

relationships.description: Typed/ is part of the same assembly and namespace.
Internal/ is part of the same assembly.
Every typed operation calls a JSON-layer function.
Validation runs on StrictJson and SchemaInterpreter; the everyday operations read and write JSON through Values.
The embedded schema is read on first use.
Zones.Resolve and Zones.ToZone use only the ZoneRules the caller passes; ZoneRules.Load reads the path the caller gives.
JsonElement for values, BigInteger for years and ticks, and DateOnly, TimeOnly, DateTime, DateTimeOffset and TimeSpan for interop.
